_설명: 천일문 3권 Chapter 09 관계사에서 가져와 변형한 문항. 은행에서는 심화 6과 관계사 자리에 합쳐 둔다.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것을 고르세요.
body: • I read the book ______(A) is now popular in Korea.
• I read the book ______(B) author is very famous.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것을 고르세요.
body: • I miss the days ______(A) we were in middle school.
• I miss the days ______(B) we spent in the countryside.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것을 고르세요.
body: • We adopted a stray dog, ______(A) recovered quickly.
• I want to meet the singer, ______(B) wrote my favorite song.

questions.prompt: 다음 두 문장을 관계부사를 사용하여 한 문장으로 쓰세요.
body: Have you ever been to the village? An old bell still rings in the village.
questions.answer: Have you ever been to the village where an old bell still rings?

questions.prompt: 다음 두 문장을 관계부사를 사용하여 한 문장으로 쓰세요.
body: Tell me the way. You solve math problems so fast in the way.
questions.answer: Tell me how you solve math problems so fast.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 관계대명사가 나머지와 다른 하나를 고르세요.

choices.text: ______ we need now is a cup of tea.
He doesn’t seem to understand ______ I’m saying.
Some people aren’t thankful for ______ they have.
The book ______ you lent me yesterday isn’t interesting.
Show me ______ you bought at the market.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 관계대명사가 나머지와 다른 하나를 고르세요.

choices.text: He’s a chef ______ restaurant is next to my school.
Emma has a cute rabbit ______ ears are very long.
A student ______ grades improved the most got a prize.
I couldn’t sleep well because of the sound ______ the rain made.
Mr. Kim is a teacher ______ class is popular among the students.

questions.prompt: 다음 문장에서 어법상 알맞지 않은 부분을 찾아 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요.
body: The girl who helps the old woman with her heavy bags are kind.

questions.prompt: 다음 문장에서 어법상 알맞지 않은 부분을 찾아 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요.
body: That the little prince wanted was a friend.

questions.prompt: 주어진 두 문장을 한 문장으로 바꿔 쓸 때, 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
body: Where is my old diary? Dad is looking for it.
→ Where is my old diary ______ Dad is looking?

questions.prompt: 주어진 두 문장을 한 문장으로 바꿔 쓸 때, 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
body: Mia drinks tea with some honey. It makes her tea sweet.
→ Mia drinks tea with some honey, ______ makes her tea sweet.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분이 어법상 알맞지 않은 것을 고르세요.

choices.text: Don’t eat food [[which has]] a lot of sugar.
This isn’t the phone [[that I’d like]] to buy.
I like people [[who are]] not afraid of change.
We stayed at the hotel [[whose garden]] was very big.
Jason is my neighbor [[who I have lived]] for five years.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 <보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 다른 것을 고르세요.
body: <보기> That’s exactly [[what]] I wanted to hear.

choices.text: I don’t buy what looks useless.
Do you know what his job is?
He made a lot of money in what he did.
I love what you gave me on my birthday.
What you told me was very helpful.

questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 바르게 배열하세요.
body: 나는 그가 웃고 있는 이유를 알고 싶다. (laughing / he / why / the reason / is)
questions.answer: the reason why he is laughing

questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 바르게 배열하세요.
body: 지난주에 내가 너에게 빌려준 우산을 돌려주겠니?
(last week / the umbrella / lent / which / I / you)
→ Can you return ________________?
questions.answer: the umbrella which I lent you last week

questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 바르게 배열하세요.
body: Brian이 일하고 있는 건물은 아름다운 강 전망을 가지고 있다. (where / Brian / works / the building)
→ ________________ has a beautiful view of the river.
